fixes.label: Raise the combined Social Security payroll tax from 12.4% to 16.65% starting in 2026 (17.30% if Congress waits until 2034).
Cut all benefits, for current and future retirees alike, by 25.2% starting in 2026 (28.5% if Congress waits until 2034).
Or cut benefits 30.3% only for people who first become eligible in 2026 or later, sparing current beneficiaries.
